title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Straw Cranberry Cherry / Cherry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This pairing gives you two red-fruit options. Straw’ Cranberry Cherry blends sweet Strawberry with a tangy Cranberry lift and juicy Cherry notes, while Cherry Ice focuses on a direct Cherry taste with a cool finish. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, the pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can fit both refills and switch at the device selector. The click-fit format keeps setup quick and tidy. A mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt deliver consistent MTL vapour and fast nicotine relief with either layered fruit or chilled cherry flavour. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
